stage_meaning.coded: the named software atom exists at its stated scope; no credit for an unimplemented broader feature
stage_meaning.tested: appropriate automated evidence for this atom passed at its referenced checkpoint; pending/failed native acceptance earns no tested credit
stage_meaning.merged: tested atom integrated into verified main
stage_meaning.production_accepted: explicit real operational acceptance evidence, never inferred from a simulation or code/test presence

method.caveat: A conservative, explicit software-coverage checklist, not production readiness, effort elapsed or commercial value. Equal category weights are a documented editorial choice. Missing or uncertain atoms receive no credit. No informal70% baseline is reused. Atom scope and required surfaces are stated; complete cross-platform parity remains separately uncredited where missing.
